pages.title: Mario as Sailor Moon with Long Hair Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Mario dressed as Sailor Moon, wearing his signature M cap, a sailor-style outfit with a large bow, and long flowing hair.

pages.title: Flying Wing Cap Mario Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Flying through the air with his winged cap, Mario stretches out his gloved hands in a dynamic jumping pose. This detailed printable coloring page shows his classic overalls, iconic mustache, and trademark cap with feathered wings, making it ideal for creative art with colored pencils.

pages.title: Cute Cat Mario and Cat Peach Kissing Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Cat Mario in his fluffy suits and Cat Peach gently kissing his cheek. The cute chibi scene features detailed cat paw pads, pointed animal ears, a pearl necklace, and a big bow tail ribbon, ideal for colored pencils or alcohol markers.

pages.title: Mario and Toad Opening a Treasure Chest Inside a Toad House Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Toad open a treasure chest inside a Toad House in this printable coloring page, revealing coins, gems, and a smiling star. The coloring sheet includes the chest's curved lid, large padlock, and side handle, with a mushroom-decorated doorway and round window behind the characters.

pages.title: Mario and Sonic Racing Through a Looped Grassland Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Sonic race side by side through a looped grassland in this printable coloring page, with raised fists, bent knees, and oversized shoes. A large loop curves behind the runners, while scattered flowers, grass tufts, and rounded hills give the coloring sheet a lightly detailed background.

pages.title: Paper Mario Swinging a Hammer in a Paper Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Paper Mario raises a large hammer in a paper village in this printable coloring page, standing beside an exclamation block on a plank path. His thick outline contrasts with the smaller windows, chimneys, bushes, and angular mountains, giving the coloring sheet both broad character areas and finer village details.

pages.title: Dr Mario Holding a Capsule Inside a Mushroom Kingdom Clinic Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dr. Mario holding a capsule inside a Mushroom Kingdom clinic, wearing a buttoned coat, stethoscope, and medical cap. A mushroom chart hangs beside the window, and a mortar and pestle sits on the counter, adding small details around the central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mario Climbing a Flagpole Outside a Mushroom Kingdom Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario climbs a tall flagpole outside a Mushroom Kingdom castle in this printable coloring page, gripping the pole beneath a flag with a mushroom emblem. Turrets, arched windows, and a large gateway fill the background, while the coloring sheet's cobblestone path adds smaller enclosed shapes below his boots.

pages.title: Mario and Princess Peach Waving in the Castle Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Princess Peach wave in the castle garden in this printable coloring page, standing among flowers with a towered castle rising behind them. Peach's jeweled crown, puffed sleeves, and layered skirt contrast with Mario's cap and overalls, while bushes and steps add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mario Emerging From a Green Pipe in a Grassy Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario emerges from a pipe in a grassy level in this printable coloring page, waving one hand while resting the other on the wide rim. A question block floats nearby, with flowers and rounded hills surrounding the pipe; broad open surfaces keep the coloring sheet focused on Mario's face and pose.

pages.title: Ice Mario Sliding Across a Frozen Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Ice Mario slides belly-first across a frozen kingdom in this printable coloring page, stretching both gloved hands forward beneath a castle with pointed towers. Snowy mountains, an icy slope, and cracks in the foreground surround his large figure, giving the coloring sheet a mix of open areas and narrow details.

pages.title: 8 Bit Mario Jumping Over a Pixel Goomba in a Classic Level Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows 8-bit Mario jumping over a pixel Goomba in a classic level, with one fist raised beside a question block. Stepped outlines define the characters and clouds, while a pipe and repeating ground blocks provide large geometric sections along the bottom of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cape Mario Soaring Above Grassy Hills in Dinosaur Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Cape Mario soars above the grassy hills of Dinosaur Land in this printable coloring page, spreading his arms as his patterned cape trails behind him. Palm trees, rounded bushes, and tall hills frame the airborne character, with broad sky and hillside spaces surrounding the smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mario and Bowser Facing Off on a Castle Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Bowser face off on a castle bridge in this printable coloring page, with Mario's fists raised opposite Bowser's horns, claws, and spiked shell. The arched bridge has individually outlined stones, and distant battlements and a tower add smaller architectural sections behind the two figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mario and Friends Celebrating in the Mushroom Kingdom Plaza Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario celebrates with Luigi, Princess Peach, Yoshi, and Toad in the Mushroom Kingdom plaza in this printable coloring page, surrounded by castle towers and stars. Peach holds a star-tipped wand beside Mario, while Toad stands at the front; cobblestones and brickwork add smaller spaces throughout the group coloring sheet.
